# Project Phoenix v59.0 (Worker 5): World Town Charters, Universal Character Interactions, Cross-Civilization Unit Abilities & Global Hegemon Edicts (prefix: oe_v59_w5_). Generated by gen_v590_world_town_rights_chars_hegemons_abilities.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_v59_w5_ci_imperial_adoption = {
	message = no
	on_own_nation = yes
	on_other_nation = no
	ai_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				government_type = government_type:monarchy
				government_type = government_type:steppe_horde
			}
			has_ruler = yes
			ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			government_power >= 15
			gold >= 50
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_v59_w5_ci_imperial_adoption_cd_tt
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_v59_w5_ci_imperial_adoption_cd }
			}
		}
	}

	cooldown = { type = oe_v59_w5_ci_imperial_adoption years = 10 }

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_character"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_v59_w5_ci_imperial_adoption_no_candidate"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
		visible = {
			is_alive = yes
			is_adult = yes
			is_ruler = no
			is_heir = no
			is_loyal = yes
			NOT = { has_character_modifier = oe_v59_w5_cm_adopted_successor }
		}
		enabled = {
			total_abilities >= 150
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_government_power = -15
			add_gold = -50
			set_variable = { name = oe_v59_w5_ci_imperial_adoption_cd value = 1 years = 10 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_ruler = yes
					ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes }
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					change_dynasty = scope:actor.ruler.dynasty
				}
			}
			set_as_designated_heir = scope:recipient
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_v59_w5_cm_adopted_successor
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -100
	}
}

		column = {
			data = name
		}
		visible = {
			is_alive = yes

				is_admiral = yes
				mil >= 60
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = -50
			add_prestige = -10
			add_army_tradition = 5
			set_variable = { name = oe_v59_w5_ci_ennoble_war_hero_cd value = 1 years = 5 }
			if = {
				limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
				add_estate_satisfaction = {
					type = estate_type:nobles_estate
					value = estate_satisfaction_weak_bonus
				}
			}
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			add_mil = 5
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:actor = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
					NOT = { has_estate = estate_type:crown_estate }
					NOT = { has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
				}
				change_character_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
			}
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_v59_w5_cm_ennobled_hero
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -100
	}
